scenario_description:
Objective: Have this afternoon’s aft canvas snap tune-up include replacing the missing fasteners, not just marking them for a later visit.
Emerging Need: The matching spares envelope needed for installation turns out to be off the boat while the installer’s specialty punch is packed only for confirmed install stops.
Decision Context: Stored onboard notes identify the correct snap hardware and where an off-boat spares envelope should be routed; live updates determine whether a drop-off can still beat technician loadout.
Consequence: Once the route packet closes, the appointment can still happen, but the replacement portion loses its practical prerequisite and the loose canvas remains deferred.

parameter.title: Oakland fabrication shop block
parameter.description: Off-boat shop work; limited ability to meet marina drop-offs.

parameter.title: Aft canvas snap tune-up
parameter.description: Dockside canvas technician visit for aft windscreen snap tension and any ready fastener replacement.

parameter.subject: Today’s aft canvas snap tune-up
parameter.body: Confirming the 5:30 PM dockside visit. I can replace loose or missing fasteners only when matching owner-supplied studs are available at the boat; otherwise I will mark the locations and leave them for a later installation. The small snap punch is packed only for confirmed install stops before route loadout.

parameter.content: I just found your kraft envelope labeled “dodger snap spares” in my van from when I compared fasteners last week, so it is definitely not on the boat. I’m near Richardson Bay until about 3:10, then going straight to Oakland overnight.

Dock ops is closing the service-cabinet log at 3:20 today for the launch-ramp drill. I can still take a small resident-labeled envelope from a known visitor before then and put it in a pickup cubby, but after 3:20 nothing else goes into resident cubbies until Monday.

parameter.subject: Route packet closed for Rook slip
parameter.body: The afternoon route packet is closed. Stops without confirmed installation hardware before loadout are inspection-only, and the snap punch was not packed for the Rook slip visit.
